court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Yogesh S/O. Kishore Dandekar vs Zilla Parishad, Wardha Thr. Its Chief ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Yogesh S/o Kisohre Dandekar, Aged about 25 years, R/o. Datta Ward, Arvi, Tahsil Arvi, Distt.Wardha.
parties.respondent_defendant: Zilla Parishad, Wardha, through its Chief Executive Officer, Wardha.

facts_of_case: Petitioner's father was a permanent employee of the respondent who expired while working. Petitioner applied for appointment on compassionate ground after attaining majority. Respondent insisted on succession certificate which was settled as per terms of compromise.

legal_principles.principle: A child born from a marriage which is null and void under Section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is legitimate.
legal_principles.held: Legitimacy of a child born from a marriage which is null and void, is a matter of public policy so as to protect a child born from such a marriage from suffering the consequences of illegitimacy.
cited_cases: Union of India v. V.R.Tripathi, (2018) SCC OnLine 3097

legal_principles.principle: A child's legitimacy is not affected by the validity or invalidity of their parents' marriage.
legal_principles.held: Legitimacy of a child born from such a marriage is a matter of public policy so as to protect a child born from such a marriage from suffering the consequences of illegitimacy.
cited_cases: Union of India v. V.R.Tripathi, (2018) SCC OnLine 3097

outcome.final_order: The present petition is filed for quashing and setting aside the impugned communication dated 16/05/2023 issued by the respondent-Zilla Parishad Wardha.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for quashing an impugned communication
